en: Hello!\pWelcome to TRAINER TOWER where\nTRAINERS gather from all over!
TRAINERS from all over the world\ngather here to battle.\pLet me see…\pRight now, there are TRAINERS only\nup to Floor {STR_VAR_1}.
TRAINERS are awaiting your\nchallenge up to the eighth floor.
Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?
Okay, I'll get the clock started,\nso give it everything you have.\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!
Please do visit us again!
That was too bad.\pI think you put in a tremendous\neffort in your battling.\pPlease come back and try again!
I hope you give it your best.
When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.
Hello…\pI am the owner of this TOWER…\pHow the sky soars above this\nrooftop…\pThe caress of the winds up here…\pIt's all so perfect…\pThe way you battled…\nIt, too, was perfection…
This is for you…

Oh!
Stupendous!\pIt's marvelous how you've come up
here so quickly.\pThe fact is, you've done it in
record time…\pI'll have your record posted at
the reception counter.
You seem to have taken your sweet\ntime getting here…
What I would like to see is a\nbetter time out of you…\pI'm counting on you.\pUntil then, farewell…
{STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sec.
This is a two-on-two battle.\pYou may not battle unless you have\nat least two POKéMON.

Here at TRAINER TOWER, there is an
event called TIME ATTACK.\pYou will be timed on how quickly
you can get from the reception\lcounter to the OWNER on the roof.\pThe best times will be recorded on
the Time Board.\pTry competing with friends to see
who can beat it the fastest.\pYou will not earn any EXP. Points
or money by beating TRAINERS here.
Thank you for competing!
I'm here to see how good I am.\pI wonder what kinds of TRAINERS\nare waiting for me?\pIt's nerve-racking!
Gasp, gasp…\nGasp…\pNever mind battling! These stairs…\nThey're tougher than any battle…
